corrected_statement: The ordered F1 (0.5 A hold, 1.0 A trip at 25C) and L1 (500 mA, 0.3 ohm) have little margin. The sim-derived cranking draw is 0.45 A at 8 V and about 0.6 A at 6 V. At 6 V the drops through D7, F1 and L1 leave U2 Vin near 4.8-5.2 V, below the LMR14020 dropout knee, so +5V sags for the length of the crank. A nuisance trip is unlikely. Hold is not trip, trip is about 2x hold, and the realistic cabin temperature is about 60C, where hold is about 0.35 A against a 0.25 A steady load. Only an extreme-hot, long, weak crank gets close. The risk is a brown-out or a warm PTC, not a certain failure.

corrected_statement: On the ordered rev 0.9 daughterboard (no D42-D49) each sequential injector driver absorbs its own turn-off energy. With 20 mH injectors that is about 15 mJ per shot, 0.9 W per driver at sustained 7200 rpm, about +44 K from the driver itself and +78-86 K over air by the repo's tool. Thermal shutdown needs a corner case: 20 mH injectors, 85 C case air, sustained redline at about 80% duty. At 8 mH or less it is harmless. The shutdown is self-protecting and recoverable. Injector inductance is unmeasured, and the repo already documents this gap and the proposed external TVS.
evidence: review brief s6 lists injector inductance 8 vs 20 mH as unknown and says the ordered temperatures assumed 8 mH. VERIFICATION.md N8 (about line 532) says sequential drivers absorb their own clamp energy and that a per-injector TVS was "Proposed, not made, measure inductance first". Rev 0.10 already adds clamps. I redid the arithmetic. At 20 mH and 1.03 A the stored energy is 10.6 mJ, and the driver takes 10.6 x 45/(45-14.4) = 15.6 mJ per turn-off. At 60 injections/s that is 0.93 W, and at 48 K/W it is +44 K. At 8 mH it is 0.37 W. The per-event energy is far below Eas of 200 mJ. The 85 C air plus 80 K shutdown case needs three assumptions that have not been checked: a 20 mH injector, 85 C air inside the stock cabin ECU case, and sustained 7200 rpm. No measured Miata injector inductance exists. The 48 K/W figure is a copper-area fit, not measured. A 16 V-class TVS clamps below the driver's 36 V minimum clamp threshold (VCLTH). Note at kb/verify/C007-consequence.md.
fix: Measure one injector's inductance with an LCR meter, which costs almost nothing. At 8 mH or less, do nothing. Above about 12 mH, hand-fit a 16 V-class TVS (SMCJ16A or 1.5SMC16A) from each injector wire to VBAT at the harness side, 4 parts for sequential cars. The 1989-93 motherboard already has D3/D4. Until measured, note a duty or rpm limit for sustained redline use.

With a 6.9-7.9 ohm OCV (14.4 V gives about 2.1 A peak) the 60 C hold current is reached at about 50-75 % duty. The claim's "1.1 A rms at 50 %" is really the mean, and rms is 1.48 A. A trip needs a hot case plus sustained high VVT duty and is slow and self-resetting. The result is temporary full retard with no damage, so risk is low, not medium. Real OCV duty and case temperature are unmeasured.
